note: Hyper-local neighbourhood social network in Germany (France, Spain, Italy), Berlin. Entry: Seed (undisclosed), 2015-11: 'Ebenso Lakestar, also Klaus Hommels. Eine imposante Runde'. Graduated: an unnamed EUR 16M round (EUR 16M), 2018-03. Entry rests on German Wikipedia only; the Burda 2018 press page (cert error) and firm post would not confirm. Handelsblatt does not name Lakestar. Status: Hubert Burda Media took the majority (61%) in September 2020, a change of control, read acquired like the other majority takeovers in this book (Solaris by SBI, Avrios by Battery).
